soldier: The head yellowish brown tinged with smoky, the anterior quarter paler; mandibles reddish brown with the basal third yellowish brown; labrum yellowish brown, antennae yellowish brown slightly tinged with smoky; pronotum pale yellow, abdomen and legs milky white. The head with scattered rather long hairs; the labrum with eight pairs of hairs in longitudinal rows on either side from the tip to the base; the periphery of the pronotum with several further long hairs. Head nearly oval, widest at the middle, the dorsum highest in the middle. Labrum lanceolate, raised in the middle. The front of the mandibles curved inwards: the inner margin of the left mandible with three marginal teeth at the middle and two or three small serrate teeth above the first marginal tooth, the base with a small pointed projection; the right mandible with small serrate teeth above the base and a small pointed projection at the base. Postmentum raised, widest slightly behind the middle. Antennae with 16 segments, the fourth shortest, the second twice the fourth. The anterior part of the pronotum slightly raised, the middle of both the anterior and posterior margins concave.
taxonomy_note: The original work places this species in the genus Parahypotermes; this site now treats it under Hypotermes, the genus name having changed.
